text: DSH Voice Conversation 是面向 DSH 网页聊天的免手操作语音插件，支持意大利语和英语。它把语音模式接入聊天输入区，并通过 DSH 主机路由连接语音识别与合成服务。用户可用停顿检测自动提交语音、听取回复、在播报时插话，并选择聊天或任务语音模式。还可配置兼容 OpenAI 音频接口的本地或远程端点。可选本地后端使用 Whisper 与 Piper；需要麦克风权限，后端需另行安装运行。

DSH Voice Conversation adds hands-free Italian and English speech to DSH web chat. It submits speech after pauses, reads replies aloud, and supports spoken interruption. Users can configure local or remote audio endpoints or install the optional local Whisper and Piper backend.
想在 DSH 聊天时直接用语音提问并听取回答。
希望说完停顿后自动把语音转成消息发给 DSH。
有没有能在 DSH 网页聊天里免手操作的语音模式？
我想边听 DSH 的回答边能开口打断它。
让 DSH 用意大利语或英语识别我的语音并朗读回复。
DSH 能否把语音输入和语音播报接到本地服务？
I want to talk to DSH hands-free and hear its replies aloud.
Can DSH transcribe my speech after I pause and submit it automatically?
DSH Voice Conversation 的语音输入：聊天语音模式持续采集麦克风音频，并用停顿检测结束录音后提交转写。用户说话内容送到所选 STT endpoint，识别结果作为 DSH 消息。
DSH Voice Conversation 的语音播报：收到完整回复后请求 TTS endpoint，将返回的 MP3 播放出来；用户在播报时说话可触发打断。原始回复仍留在 DSH 聊天中。
DSH Voice Conversation 的本地双语语音：可选后端用 Whisper 识别意大利语或英语，并用 Piper 合成对应语音；配置 Kokoro 时也可选择其语音。服务提供转写和 MP3 合成接口。
DSH Voice Conversation 的聊天与任务语音预设：开启语音模式后，插件向 DSH 系统提示注入对应指令，要求回答适合朗读并使用用户刚说的语言；聊天预设还引导快速简短回应。
DSH Voice Conversation 默认把识别和合成请求发往本机 127.0.0.1:8766；远程端点需在插件设置中明确配置，配置后语音音频或文本会发送到该服务。

dsh-voice-conversation README · DSH Voice Conversation：Maintainer / autore del fork: **[RedHunt07](https://github.com/redhunt07)** · License: **MIT**. Original Voice Loop code by ZG2017; see [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).
Hands-free Italian/English conversations for DSH. Speak, pause for 1.7 seconds, and your prompt is submitted. After the final spoken reply, listening resumes using the same microphone stream. A compact composer dock keeps the native chat, tools and DSH-provided Think output visible. This displays reasoning exposed by DSH, not private model reasoning.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Compatibility：Tested: **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**, Node.js 22+, Linux web profile. Other DSH releases, operating systems and browsers need validation. Microphone access requires localhost or HTTPS and browser permission. Use headphones to reduce loudspeaker echo triggering spoken interruption.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Install：npm package: **[dsh-voice-conversation](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-voice-conversation)** (release **0.1.2**).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-conversation
```

This installs the current npm release. To pin the verified version:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-conversation@0.1.2
```

The previous **0.1.1** release is also available as a prebuilt archive below.

```sh

dsh-voice-conversation README · equivalent prebuilt GitHub archive：dsh plugin --profile web add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redhunt07/dsh-voice-conversation/main/dist/dsh-voice-conversation-0.1.1.tgz
```

dsh-voice-conversation README · equivalent prebuilt GitHub archive：The DSH command also selects the bundle. Verify that `"dsh-voice-conversation"` occurs once in `dsh.profile.bundles` in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json` (normally `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`); add it only if missing and preserve existing entries. Disable any older Voice Loop bundle first: the two plugins use the same API paths and cannot run together. Restart DSH and hard-refresh the browser.
dsh-voice-conversation README · equivalent prebuilt GitHub archive：No backend, global transcript preferences or background services are installed automatically.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Optional local backend：Extract the source archive and open its directory. Prerequisites: `python3`, [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/), and `ffmpeg` on PATH. Setup creates an isolated Python 3.12 environment, downloading the interpreter through uv if necessary, and downloads approximately 3.1 GB of pinned Whisper/Piper model files. Review [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) first.

```sh
python3 scripts/runtime.py setup --device cpu
python3 scripts/runtime.py start
```

dsh-voice-conversation README · Optional local backend：Whisper large-v3 can be slow on CPU. On Linux with a compatible NVIDIA CUDA 12 driver and sufficient VRAM (tested on a 16 GB GPU), use `setup --device cuda` instead. Setup installs pinned CUDA libraries inside its environment, not system drivers or system packages.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Optional local backend：Keep the foreground process running; Ctrl+C stops it. Data lives at `~/.local/share/dsh-voice-conversation`; `--data-dir PATH` overrides it. Whisper uses the standard Hugging Face cache. Inspect configuration and service availability with:

```sh
python3 scripts/runtime.py doctor
```

dsh-voice-conversation README · Optional local backend：The backend binds only to `127.0.0.1:8766`. DSH must run on the same machine; its host proxies the audio. Browser-origin requests are rejected. Local processes can access this unauthenticated backend; keep the port private. For remote browser access, DSH still needs HTTPS for microphone permissions.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Use and configure：Enable Voice Mode once in a DSH chat and allow the microphone. Select local recognition/synthesis. Choose `paola` for Italian speech or `lessac` for English. Recognition automatically chooses between Italian and English; output uses the selected voice and does not automatically switch language.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Use and configure：The dock shows listening, processing and speaking. Responses are read only after the agent finishes; intermediate tool-step text is skipped. Speak over a reply to interrupt it. Approval requests remain in the normal chat and can require a click. Close Voice Mode to release the microphone.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Use and configure：The default endpoints are `http://127.0.0.1:8766/v1/audio/transcriptions` and `/v1/audio/speech`. The local/cloud selectors are two configurable slots; both initially point to localhost. Configure compatible remote endpoints and credentials explicitly in plugin settings if desired. There is no implicit remote fallback or ambient API-key lookup. STT accepts multipart `file` and `model`, returns JSON `{text}`. TTS accepts JSON `{model,input,voice,lang_code,response_format:"mp3"}`, returns MP3 bytes.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Use and configure：Native Think sections open once while voice mode is active; manual collapse is respected. For more activity detail, optionally choose verbose transcript and detailed usage in DSH's own settings. The plugin does not override these global preferences.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Privacy and limits：The supplied backend processes audio in memory and does not save recordings or transcript logs. Transcribed prompts and replies remain in DSH's normal session history and follow the selected chat model's data handling. Remote speech endpoints receive audio/text when explicitly configured. Setup needs internet; cached local speech models run offline afterward. The chat model can still use a remote provider.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Privacy and limits：Pause detection and barge-in use audio energy, not semantic end-of-turn detection. Room noise, microphone gain and echo affect them. Recordings are capped at 120 seconds; audio requests time out after 90 seconds; playback has a watchdog and can truncate unusually long replies. The voice prompt requests concise answers while active.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Privacy and limits：Tests simulate microphone/audio events and cover VAD, the dock, consecutive replies, tool-step filtering, TTS failure, interrupted synthesis, agent errors, and missing playback completion. Real-room microphone testing is still required before a stable public release. Version 0.1.1 is an initial release candidate.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Develop and publish：```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build
npm test
npm pack

`prepack` rebuilds and tests. Browser code is hand-written JavaScript. Python dependency locks and model revisions are included. There are no npm install lifecycle hooks. An explicit file allowlist excludes models, environments, credentials and session history.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Develop and publish：The npm name `dsh-voice-conversation` is already published and linked to this repository. For a new release, increment the version, update the changelog, rebuild and test before deliberately running `npm publish --access public`. If renaming, update `package.json`, `src/client.js` and `cordis.patch.yml` together. No registry publication is performed by setup.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Develop and publish：To uninstall, remove the bundle entry, run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-voice-conversation`, and restart DSH. Runtime data and shared model caches are not automatically deleted.

dsh-voice-conversation README · More natural local Italian speech (0.1.1)：Choose the optional Kokoro backend during setup: `python3 scripts/runtime.py setup --device cuda --tts kokoro` (or `--device cpu`). Start normally afterward. Setup downloads a pinned ONNX model and voice bank (~354 MB extra), verifies SHA-256, and installs separate optional dependencies. The local model provides `if_sara` and `im_nicola` for Italian, and `af_heart` for English. The engine preserves sentence/clause pauses and normalizes Markdown for speech; the chat text is unchanged. Piper remains the default for existing runtime setups. With Kokoro enabled, legacy Paola/Lessac selections map to Sara/Heart. Voice quality is subjective and is not equivalent to a commercial realtime voice service.

dsh-voice-conversation README · More natural local Italian speech (0.1.1)：The patch also fixes delayed chat completion, same-turn approval continuations, no-op submissions, queued media abort/pause events and Italian alternate-voice selection. Autoplay/synthesis failures are shown in the dock rather than silently skipped.

dsh-voice-conversation README · GitHub Packages：The repository's **Packages** sidebar contains the public [@redhunt07/dsh-voice-conversation](https://github.com/users/redhunt07/packages/npm/package/dsh-voice-conversation) package, version **0.1.1**. The scoped GitHub distribution adjusts the package, browser module and bundle identities together. [Registry setup and installation](docs/github-packages.md). Choose either the npm distribution or the GitHub Packages distribution in a profile; do not enable both at once.

dsh-voice-conversation README · Plugin Hub：The plugin is [listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/redhunt07/dsh-voice-conversation). The official badge above links directly to its catalog page. The original submission is tracked in [DSH Plugin Hub issue #548](https://github.com/dshplugin/dsh-plugin-hub/issues/548).

dsh-voice-conversation README · Plugin Hub：The repository is public, carries the GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, has a root `package.json`, and exports the host plugin through `lib/index.js` (`apply`, `name`, `inject`, `Config`). [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) contains the source `apply(ctx, config)` implementation.

dsh-voice-conversation README · 0.1.2 catalog compatibility：The 0.1.2 package adds the `dsh-plugin` / `deepseek-harness` npm keywords and emits a direct `export function apply(ctx, config)` declaration in the built entry. This matches the entry style of listed plugins while preserving the same function implementation. It is a precaution for static discovery; the Hub scanner code is not public, so the exclusion reason remains unconfirmed.
